title: In the Tropics
description: A scarlet macaw (Ara macao) hangs from a tree in Tikal National Park, Guatemala. The bird is native to subtropical rainforests across Central and South America and is classified as endangered due to various threats, including the illegal wildlife trade. While the average lifespan of a scarlet macaw in the wild is between 40 and 50 years, they can live up to 75 years in captivity.
translated_description: 一只绯红金刚鹦鹉（Ara macao）悬挂在危地马拉蒂卡尔国家公园的一棵树上。这种鸟类原产于中美洲和南美洲的亚热带雨林，由于包括非法野生动物贸易在内的多种威胁，被列为濒危物种。绯红金刚鹦鹉在野外的平均寿命为40至50年，但在人工饲养条件下可存活长达75年。
